headline_marked: [[President Mirza Fakhrul to visit Thakurgaon]] for first time since taking office
headline: President Mirza Fakhrul to visit Thakurgaon for first time since taking office
summary: Bangladesh's 23rd President, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, is set for a two-day visit to his home district of Thakurgaon, his first since taking office. He will lay the foundation stone for Thakurgaon University and attend various programs.
details: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will visit his home district of Thakurgaon for the first time since assuming office as the 23rd President of the country. He is scheduled for a two-day tour starting Sunday, September 6.

During his visit, the President will lay the foundation stone for Thakurgaon University and participate in various other programs. He will depart Dhaka by helicopter at 10 AM on Sunday, arriving at Mohammad Ali Stadium field at 11:40 AM, where he will receive a Guard of Honor before proceeding to the Circuit House.

Later, President Alamgir will visit the family graveyard in Senuapara to pray at the graves of his late father, former minister Mirza Ruhul Amin, and mother, Fatema Begum. He will then go to his residence in Kalibari, followed by lunch and rest.
In the afternoon, he will attend a civic reception at Thakurgaon Government Boys' High School field. He will spend the night at his residence.

On the second day of the visit, the President will lay the foundation stone for the proposed Thakurgaon University in Jamalpur area, beside the Thakurgaon-Pirganj road. After visiting his residence and the Circuit House again, he is expected to depart for Dhaka by helicopter.

headline: SB police officer beaten to death in Savar after protesting assault on auto-rickshaw driver
summary: Md Altaf Hossain, 57, an SB sub-inspector, was killed in Aminbazar, Savar, after intervening in an assault. His son was critically injured and their factory vandalized in the attack.
details: A sub-inspector of the Special Branch (SB) of police was beaten to death in Savar after he allegedly protested when a group of youths assaulted an elderly auto-rickshaw driver. His son was also seriously injured in the attack, while a factory owned by the police officer was vandalised.

The incident took place around 10:00pm yesterday in the Janata Housing area of Aminbazar in Savar. The deceased was identified as Md Altaf Hossain, 57, an SB sub-inspector posted with the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, according to Savar Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Saiful Alam.

Altaf, who lived in a rented house in the Janata Housing area with his family, was returning home from his small garment factory. He reportedly witnessed several youths in a private car assaulting an elderly auto-rickshaw driver near his residence.
When Altaf protested the assault, the youths allegedly turned on him and began beating him. At one point, Altaf identified himself as a police officer and ran into his factory to save himself.

The youths then reportedly called 15-20 others and attacked the factory. They entered, vandalised machinery and other items, and allegedly beat Altaf and his son Arif, leaving them unconscious before fleeing.

Later, neighbours took Altaf and Arif to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared Altaf dead. Arif is currently undergoing treatment at the hospital in a critical condition, the OC confirmed. Police efforts are underway to identify and arrest those involved.
